title: Longest run
prompt:
Return the **length of the longest run** of identical adjacent characters. Case matters: 'b' and 'B' are different characters. Implement `process(String s)` (0 for empty).

Example: `"aaBBBbc"` → `3` (the BBB run).

tests.name: longest run length
tests.hint: cur = (i > 0 && charAt(i) == charAt(i-1)) ? cur + 1 : 1; track max.
